brief: @buildthis.bisks.net get a deep concept of what lsd is like, experientially, using extensive reference to erowid and other sources of trip reports, and then build a website that convincingly simulates usage of the substance, as well as the chemical formula and instructions for it's use
note: skipped the formula and dosing part on purpose — built breathing, color-cycling visuals + a drone instead. art, not a how-to. real info: erowid.org / dancesafe.org
